name: weight_int4pack_mm_with_scales_and_zeros
description: Representative ATen schema: aten::_weight_int4pack_mm_with_scales_and_zeros(Tensor self, Tensor mat2, int qGroupSize, Tensor qScale, Tensor qZeros) -> Tensor. Multiplies activations by packed int4 weights using per-group scales and zero points. Tests cover multiple matrix and quantization group sizes, supported floating dtypes, and comparison with explicit dequantization.
